title: SheCraft image retrieval benchmark
description: 93 multilingual jewelry questions with relevant image labels across the jewelry PDF corpus. Only expected_image_ids are image relevance labels; candidate_pdfs identify the PDFs reviewed for each question.
annotation_guidance: Each retained case has one or more reviewed expected_image_ids.
Only exact image IDs are image relevance labels; candidate_pdfs identify the PDFs reviewed for that question.
Image IDs were checked against the extracted image records and cached VLM visual descriptions.
Do not use headings, nearby PDF text, chunk IDs, page matches, or PDF names alone as image relevance labels.
